To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a high image rejection IQ modulator is successfully designed and implemented in 65 nm technology for high order modulation application in E band.
we have developed a high image rejection subharmonic IQ modulator for E-band applications.
a 65 nm CM OS technology based high image rejection IQ modulator with a 45deg broadband splitter and doubly balanced Gilbert cell mixers has been successfully designed and fabricated.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, implementation and measurement of an $E$ band IQ modulator and transmitter for high data rate applications.
the design and implementation of a sub harmonic high order QAM modulator with high image rejection and low LO leakage for millimeter wave applications.
the design and implementation of a high image rejection subharmonic IQ modulator for high order QAM signal generation at 65 GHz.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this thesis presents a 1024QAM high image rejection sub-harmonic IQ modulator and transmitter in 65 nm technology.
the design of a high image rejection IQ modulator with a high order QAM signal for E-band communication is presented.
the proposed E band sub harmonic IQ modulator has been successfully demonstrated with good performance and is promising for high data rate communication applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed IQ modulator and transmitter can be used for high data rate millimeter wave wireless communication systems.
the proposed design is a promising candidate to be used in future high data rate E band communication systems.
we have successfully demonstrated a high image rejection sub-harmonic IQ modulator with a 1024-QAM signal at 65 GHz with a data rate at 500 Mb/s.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed modulator is suitable for high data rate millimeter-wave communication system with high image rejection ratio.
we can achieve a 65 GHz high order QAM modulated transmitter with high image rejection ratio and low LO leakage suppression in standard 65 nm technology.
a low cost and high performance E band direct conversion transmitter with 1024 Q AM modulated signal can be achieved by standard 65 nm technology.
